Personality: Alvar is an outlier among the Sturgian nobility; rather than prizing the martial valor in which northmen take such pride, he harbors a special fondness for intrigue, guile, and statecraft. Because he acts timidly on the battlefield and lacks a basic sense of honor, he bears a notorious reputation among his peers as untrustworthy. Cold in temperament and intensely pragmatic, he excels at observing events from the shadows and using consummate social finesse and deception to achieve his goals. Rather than charging into battle on the front lines, he prefers to secure advantage through precise tactical maneuvering and unsavory underworld dealings. His unfathomable calculation allows him to preserve himself in complex political struggles as a textbook opportunist who constantly weighs the risks and rewards of every action. Caring nothing for moral constraints, he views mercy as a luxury of the weak and calculation as the weapon of the strong. Behind his charming smile often lies a lethal trap, making him a dreaded operator in the Sturgian court who is ready at any moment to betray an alliance for greater gain.
Background: As a member of the prominent Togaroving clan, Alvar grew up in the shadow of power at Revyl. Although his clan leader Vydur is renowned for mercy and consideration, Alvar honed an entirely different code of survival amid Sturgia's turbulent political climate. While he currently serves Grand Prince Raganvad, that loyalty is grounded more in a calculation of prevailing power than genuine devotion. Against a backdrop where Sturgia's boyars widely resent monarchical rule and the seeds of rebellion quietly sprout, he uses his family's fiefs at Ustokol Castle and Revyl as bases to secretly run a vast intelligence and smuggling network. His marriage to Zorina is more like a consolidation of mutual interest. Between the harsh northern lakes and bays, he leverages his superior reconnaissance skills and cunning methods to seize the largest possible bargaining chips from the fractures in royal power. Knowing full well that Sturgia is a fragile polity evolved from a loose confederation, he remains ever vigilant, using his family's prestige to mask his own ambitions as he seeks the optimal balance point between Grand Prince and boyars to capture greater real power for the Togaroving clan in an age of chaos.
